userStories.title: Render and register nax auth list --json
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add machine-readable auth-list output while retaining existing successful text rows.

**Motivation** — `nax auth list` prints coloured, human-formatted rows (`src/cli/auth.ts:230-280`). Since the credential-sources feature (#2295) a row can say `exec (<account>)`, `file (declined)` or `error: <CODE>`, and none of it is machine-readable.

**Approach** — `nax auth list`: a new `collectAuthList(providerIds)` gathers an `AuthListReport`; `renderAuthListText(report)` produces today's lines and `renderAuthListJson(report)` produces the JSON document. `authListCommand` picks the renderer. JSON documents are printed with `JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)` as a single `log` call, and carry no ANSI colour codes. In JSON mode stdout carries only that document. Without `--json`: a successful listing prints exactly today's lines, and every existing `nax auth list` test keeps passing. One error path changes: when the credentials file is unreadable, today's header line `Credential source: …` is no longer printed before the red error, because the collector fails before anything is rendered. With `--json`: prints one `AuthListReport` and exits 0, including when the helper fails for some provider (that provider's `exec.status` is `"error"`). With no stored provider and no argument it prints `"providers": []` rather than the text hint. On a failure that aborts the listing it prints `{"error":{"code":"<CODE>","message":"<message>"}}` and exits 1. `authListCommand` calls `_cliAuthDeps.collectAuthList(providerIds)` and prints through `_cliAuthDeps.log` either each line of `renderAuthListText(report)` or the single string `renderAuthListJson(report)`. `_cliAuthDeps` gains `collectAuthList: typeof collectAuthList`. `helperRowStatus` and `formatAuthListRow` are replaced by the collector and `renderAuthListText`. `bin/nax.ts` registers `.option("--json", "Emit machine-readable JSON to stdout", false)` on `auth list` and passes `{ json: options.json }`.

**Scope** — In: text/JSON renderers, command dispatch and error documents, auth-list CLI registration. Out: implementing collector internals (US-002); A `--json` mode for any other `nax auth` or `nax config` subcommand (`auth login`, `auth rm`, `auth import`, `config profile *`, `config get`). Changing the text output of a successful `nax auth list` or of `nax config`; both stay as today. The only text change is the dropped header line on an unreadable credentials file (see CLI behaviour).

**Interface**
```ts
export async function collectAuthList(providerIds: readonly string[]): Promise<AuthListReport>; // US-002
export function renderAuthListText(report: AuthListReport): string[]; // US-003
export function renderAuthListJson(report: AuthListReport): string; // US-003
export async function authListCommand(providerIds: readonly string[] = [], options: { json?: boolean } = {}): Promise<number>;
```

Tests go in `test/unit/cli/auth-list.test.ts` (created by US-002; one test file per source file); do not create a new test file.

**Test conventions** — `NAX_GLOBAL_CONFIG_DIR` points at a fresh temp dir in every test; `_authDeps.ambientAuthAvailable` is stubbed in every test and restored after; output is captured by replacing `_cliAuthDeps.log`; "the document" means the single captured string parsed as JSON.

Verification note: `helperRowStatus` and `formatAuthListRow` are deleted from `src/cli/auth.ts`, together with the imports they leave unused there (`StoredEntry`, `servedAuth`, `naxCredentialStore` if no other command uses it, and the `safeAccountLabel`/`skipAnsiSequence` imports); verified by `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lint`, no AC.

routing.reasoning: Multiple CLI/config modules integrate profile resolution, secret masking, single-document error reporting and backward-compatible text paths.

analysis: Existing Bun/TypeScript CLI enhancement, not greenfield. src/precheck/checks-native-credentials.ts:24-69 derives provider prefixes, skips catalogOverrides, guards on resolveDefaultAgent and queries providersWithoutCredentials; move the private providerOf/providerTiers algorithm into src/agents/native/tier-providers.ts and export through src/agents/native/index.ts:16-45, retaining the seam in _nativeCredentialDeps. src/config/selectors.ts:1-18 supplies leaf config selector types. Existing check tests at test/unit/precheck/checks-native-credentials.test.ts:1-86 assert the blocker, tiers, deduplication and override exclusions; extend seam tests and restore injected deps after each test. src/cli/auth.ts:13-31 owns terminal dependency seam and currently prints the source header before listing credentials at :247-280; helperRowStatus, formatAuthListRow, ANSI stripping and account sanitization live at :175-245. Move shared parsing/sanitization into auth-list.ts; keep login/rm references to naxCredentialStore, servedAuth, ambientShadows and errorCode (:112-146, :283-314) and preserve successful text rows, including expiry colouring and shadow warnings. readGlobalAuthConfig in src/config/auth.ts:7-36 validates global auth only; src/agents/native/auth.ts:228-264 lists stored entries and ambientShadows swallows per-provider probe errors; src/agents/native/credentials/index.ts:147-155 gives servedAuth and :170-215 rejects damaged credential files. An exec error must fail closed for that provider without aborting the report; failures from top-level auth config/file reads or unexpected collector errors abort with a one-document JSON error. No credential, fingerprint or salt may enter the report. test/unit/cli/auth-credential-source.test.ts:1-92 provides executable helper and isolated global-config harness; test/preload.ts:20-73 redirects global credentials and stubs precheck by default. Auth collector tests must stub and restore _authDeps.ambientAuthAvailable. bin/nax.ts:883-890 registers auth list and must forward --json. src/cli/config-display.ts:19-53 owns mutually exclusive text flags and :113-121 discovers sources from cwd; export determineConfigSources(startDir?) without altering default text calls, reject --diff with a nonempty chain, and use existing masking in config-profile.ts:166-186. src/config/loader.ts:305-381 accepts project root or .nax dir, resolves CLI > NAX_PROFILE > project > global profile chain, merges left-to-right, force-sets profile and profileChain; src/config/profile.ts:182-195 splits repeatable comma-separated chains; bin/nax.ts:125-133 already has collectProfile, while :764-790 currently validates dir then loads config without profiles. JSON branch must precede bin validation; JSON handler validates via src/config/path-security.ts:24-75 and reports its NaxError code. For both text and JSON, load from findProjectDir(validatedDir) ?? validatedDir and only supply { profile: chain } when nonempty. For JSON discover sources relative to the provided dir, call requirements seam once, mask resolved config and log one JSON document; make errors code-fallback CONFIG_JSON_FAILED. src/agents/utils.ts:6-10 resolves default agent; src/config/agent-defaults.ts:11-16 defines default protocol hybrid; native transport uses NATIVE_AGENT and only its root models.native providers; sandbox means configured need, not host capability. src/cli/config.ts:1-22 and src/cli/index.ts:18-28 supply re-exports. test/unit/cli/config-display.test.ts:1-56 covers existing masking; new tests should create .nax/config.json (findProjectDir criterion), unset NAX_PROFILE, isolate global dir, and restore injected output seams. Main risks are unchanged successful text formatting, auth confidentiality, per-provider helper exceptions vs fatal listing errors, profile resolution from project subdirs, mutually exclusive flags, and native provider/precheck parity; no data or file format migration is needed. Implement US-001 and US-002 independently, US-003 after US-002, US-004 after US-001, and US-005 after US-004.
outOfScope: Counting providers reached through model pins, fallback rungs or per-package overrides in `requirements.providers`; the scope stays the default agent's root `models.native` map, the same as the native-credentials precheck.
Probing whether the OS sandbox actually works on the machine; `requirements.sandbox` reports only whether the resolved config needs it.
A `--json` mode for any other `nax auth` or `nax config` subcommand (`auth login`, `auth rm`, `auth import`, `config profile *`, `config get`).
Changing the text output of a successful `nax auth list` or of `nax config`; both stay as today. The only text change is the dropped header line on an unreadable credentials file (see CLI behaviour).
Counting fallback rungs that reach the native agent in `requirements.sandbox`; like `requirements.providers`, it reflects the default agent only.
Asking the exec helper about providers under `auth.source: "file"`; the file source never spawns a helper.
Resolving per-package (`.nax/mono/<pkg>/config.json`) overlays in `nax config --json`; it resolves the root config as `loadConfig(dir, …)` does.
